title: Tenma Saki — An Unexpected Phone Call〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Valentine's Day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Today's the day.
Are you both ready?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes! I'm really looking forward to seeing how Ichi and the others react!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Me too!
I can't wait to see the look on everyone's faces☆

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, you both sound good and ready. Let's do this...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Secret Valentine's Day Alliance, are you ready?!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And if anything does come up, feel free to message me about it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thank you so much!
And you can always let us know if anything happens on your end, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks, I'll do that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, let's adjourn this meeting and wish each other the best of luck today!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay! Oh, but before we do...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Roger!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Airi, can you give us just another second before you head back to class?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm? Sure, what's up?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh...
Our plan's actually already in motion.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? What plan...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm ready, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Emu
rows.Line:
Airi, Happy Valentine's Day♪
Airi! Happy Valentine's Day♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? Wait, this is...!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. This is our gift to you Airi!
A surprise chocolate cake!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We actually made this in secret while we were decorating our cakes☆

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Really?! I had no idea!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Wow! A heart-shaped chocolate cake!
And this marzipan doll...! Is this me?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I tried copying you when making this, but I just wasn't able to make it as well as you probably would have...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No, you've captured me beautifully.
Especially the way she's smiling! I love it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Y-You really do?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Great job, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Please allow us to thank you again for teaching us how to bake and make our own sweets!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We were able to bake the cakes we were hoping for because of you, and we're also gonna get to surprise all of our friends as planned!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So we put lots and lots of love into this cake to show our appreciation for you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You two...
Thank you! I'm totally speechless!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You both got me pretty good with this one!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Based on this, I'm sure your surprises today will go off without a hitch!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Did you hear that, Saki?!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Emu
rows.Line: Yay♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But I think we've kept you long enough.
We should probably head back...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Not so fast!
You're not heading back now, are you...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
Looks like great minds think alike.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: W-Wait, does that mean...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yup! You two aren't the only ones that prepared a surprise!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Ta-daa♪
This is my gift to you for working so hard to make your friends smile!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow! This chocolate cake's a star!
And it has marzipan dolls of us!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: L-Look how detailed it is! We're in our uniforms and she even got our hair right, including my ribbons!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're really the best, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I just wanted to bake a cake worthy of my wonderful comrades from the Secret Valentine's Day Alliance.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, we mutually succeeded with our surprises, so I say we're all off to a great start.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right.
I feel way more confident now about what's coming later!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, one last time! Let's make sure our surprises go well today!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also, why don't we meet for a little afterparty the following weekend?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds fun!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I definitely wanna hear about how everyone reacted to your cakes, Emu, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then it's settled! That means we'll all need to do everything we can to have something good to report!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, why don't we also do that thing one last time?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Secret Valentine's Day Alliance, are you ready?!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!
